Rows: 1,293 plants in "Plant data"; 1,848 rows in "Plant capacities and status" (a plant can have several, one per status and equipment); 918 plants with an operating row that gives a crude steel capacity.

A plant's capacity is the sum of Nominal crude steel capacity (ttpa) over its rows with Status "operating" or "operating pre-retirement" (still producing; the status column says which), divided by 1,000 to give million tonnes a year (Mt/yr). Iron-only capacity is not counted.
Coordinates is one text cell, "latitude, longitude".
Check: 29 kept plants have more than one operating row.

Check: largest plants: POSCO Gwangyang steel plant (KOR) 23 Mt/yr; Angang Steel Co Ltd (CHN) 20.65 Mt/yr; Baoshan Iron and Steel Co Ltd Headquarters (CHN) 19.8 Mt/yr; POSCO Pohang steel plant (KOR) 18.76 Mt/yr; Maanshan Iron and Steel Co Ltd (CHN) 17.34 Mt/yr.
Published: GEM names the release month only; 2026-09-01 stands for September 2026 and is never shown as a day.
File choice: the plant-level workbook is the only one of the three steel files with each plant's coordinates, status and crude steel capacity; the steel and iron unit files have no coordinates.
